title: Using generative AI to create cinematic teasers for my 2D indie game (Workflow + Gameplay transition included)
author: Just_Amoeba7123
selftext:
Hi everyone! I'm developing a 2D indie game (with AI) called **SoulWave**, and I wanted to share a teaser featuring one of our bosses, Poppy (the Puppet of the Gaze.), and our one of a several of class, a Samurai character.

One of the core mechanics I'm currently developing for the game is a **Mount System**, which is why you see the Samurai riding his loyal feline guardian in this clip! 

To create this promotional material and the initial character concepts, I heavily relied on generative AI. Here is my workflow:

* **Concept Art:** I used Google AI Studio + ChatGPT to explore and refine the initial "creepy gothic marionette" aesthetic and the giant cat mount design.
* **Video Generation:** To bring these static concepts to life for this cinematic teaser, I animated the images using Google Flow (image-to-video).
* **Game Integration:** At the end of the video (around 0:24), you can see how these high-fidelity AI concepts actually translate into the real 2D stylized gameplay of SoulWave.

I'd love to hear your feedback on the character design, the mount concept, and the AI workflow!
